build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameter sweeps for bar height and ball size
create_scene_objects: create static and dynamic bars and balls in a PHYRE scene using C.add with position and scale parameters
define_task_goal: define a PHYRE task goal by calling C.update_task with body1 body2 and TOUCHING spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task solution tier metadata using C.set_meta with SolutionTier.BALL
configure_search_params: configure PHYRE task search parameters with required_flags excluded_flags and diversify_tier options
